title: Angelina Alexander's grave marker, photograph 1 of 3
credit: Shown in the post; the flowers were sent by Michael Dykhorst in 2024, for the 38th anniversary of her death

notes.note: The marker reads "Angelina Alexander, July 21, 1917 – Dec. 28, 1986"; the photographs don't show the cemetery, which the post and her obituary name as Happy Homestead. Snow and the anniversary flowers: December 2024, by the post's caption.
The post shows it at 3-p22 ("Three photos of Angie's grave"); first filed here as added beyond the post and unverified, corrected to the post's own image.
